conflicts: House of Stake power has other forms Petal does not draw here: the vote.dao proposals' own vote tallies (per-voter votes are not read), lockup-contract staking, and off-chain delegate profiles; this flower draws only veNEAR voting power
inferred: That many veNEAR accounts delegate power to a small set of delegates suggests a delegated-governance pattern, but the delegations themselves are not drawn in this flower

mappings.why: each petal's width band is the account's share of total veNEAR voting power
the bar's height is the square root of the account's voting-power share, so large and small holders stay visible on one canvas
colour distinguishes named accounts (their account id, self-declared) from anonymous implicit accounts
solid outline marks a self-declared name; unknown accounts get no outline
petals run clockwise from the top, largest voting power first

power_means.claim: Voting power in the House of Stake is veNEAR: NEAR locked in the venear contract, grown by lock time, with holders able to delegate up to 8 ways; a holder's power is own veNEAR minus outgoing delegations plus incoming.
Power is highly concentrated: 5 accounts reach a majority of veNEAR voting power, the top 10 hold about 81%, and the Gini of 0.976 says most accounts hold very little.

interpretation.summary: A fresh flower of NEAR's House of Stake at block 223162278 (2026-11-05), drawing veNEAR voting power: 519 accounts hold about 5.36M veNEAR. Power is concentrated - 5 accounts (the Nakamoto count) reach a majority, the top 10 hold ~81%, and 405 tail accounts hold ~0.014% together. The two largest petals are unnamed implicit accounts (about 15.3% and 12.8%).
unknowns: Addresses are not people: named accounts are self-declared names, not verified identities, and the two largest petals are anonymous implicit accounts with no owner known
Who controls each account (off-chain identity, multisig members, or the entity behind implicit accounts) is not on-chain and was not checked
Each holder's lockup contract and its staking, and off-chain delegate profiles, are not included
The 42 delegates receive delegations from 145 accounts, but this flower counts voting power by holder, not delegation flow

turns.content:
A fresh one, made just now — snapshot read live this session.

- **Flower**: `/draft?flower=9a93948f6b22083f`
- **What you'll see**: 61 petals (60 largest veNEAR holders + the tail). Power sits with 5 accounts — together they reach a majority (Nakamoto = 5 of 519). The two largest petals are anonymous implicit accounts (~15.3% and ~12.8%); then named accounts like spareuni818.near (~8.3%). Top 10 hold ~81%; 405 tail accounts hold ~0.014% (Gini 0.976).
- **Mapping**: width — share of veNEAR voting power [venear-accounts, hos-source]; height — √ of that share (same sources); colour & outline — named vs anonymous, self-declared names solid [account-id]; order — largest first, clockwise [venear-accounts].
- **Changed from default**: colour → identity (named/anonymous); height → sqrt. Everything else default/v1.
- **What this can't tell you**: addresses are not people — the big unnamed accounts' owners are unknown; lockup staking, delegate profiles and per-voter votes aren't included. Power here is veNEAR (locked NEAR, grown by lock time, delegable up to 8 ways), which differs from proposal vote tallies.
